card.name: Words just before a described detail
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces right before a description, such as 'Prevention' ending an agency name, 'a' before a named treatment, or the space before a number of days in a dosing schedule.

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: A blank space before a number of days after 'every N hours for' in a dosing line.
modes.example: 600 mg of TPOXX every 8 hours for<< >>14 days Pediatrics and adult patients weighing

modes.label: Linking word before explanation
modes.description: A small word such as 'a', 'that', 'will' or 'first' just before a statement that describes or explains something.
modes.example: The IFSP<< will>> describe the child’s unique needs as well

modes.label: End of agency name
modes.description: The last word of a named agency, right before a verb that says what it provides.
modes.example: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and<< Prevention>> has more about sun protection.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like outline, outlining and tracked, which suggest a description or summary comes next.
card.plain: It fires at spots where the text is about to lay out or describe details, such as a treatment, a plan or a dosing length.
